name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing with peer full delivery, immutable evidence, and candidate-bound review.

interface.shortDescription: Risk-gated solo, delegate, audit, or peer full delivery with evidence-bound review.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps architecture, scheduling, decisions, and acceptance with the root. Before work begins, it declares a SELECTIVE ROUTE and one shared acceptance basis. Solo remains the default; delegate uses one implementer; audit adds candidate-bound fresh review; exceptional full may schedule independent peer Sol implementer work, mechanically assemble exact deliveries, and ask one fresh read-only Sol reviewer to validate the real combined candidate. Immutable run records, recovery rules, and exact candidate identity fail closed without changing non-full semantics.
defaultPrompt: For root startup, load only skill guidance, then declare the route before other task tools; never batch loading with task discovery. Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
